lines.en: I trot across the drained ground
The soil crumbles at every step
My belly hugs my ribs
I walk and search for food

lines.zh: 干裂的地面刮着我的爪子
lines.en: The cracked ground scrapes my claws

lines.zh: 我踩在我们同群的印上
lines.en: I walk in the herd's tracks

lines.zh: 我瘦得能看见骨头的形状
lines.en: I am so thin you can see the shape of my bones
The wind blows dead grass into my face
I circle the clearing once
My breathing is short and quick
I cross the Hungering Fields
Every step looks like searching for something

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上像一根枯枝
lines.en: My shadow on the ground looks like a dead twig

lines.zh: 我一步一步往有味道的地方走
lines.en: I walk step by step toward the smell
My leg joints click loudly

lines.zh: 我跟着同伴，不落在最后
lines.en: I keep with the herd, never at the back
I step across a patch of broken bone
When the wind stops I stop and wait
I stand still in the dead grass
My jaw opens and closes slightly

lines.zh: 我在听土里有没有东西
lines.en: I listen for something under the soil

lines.zh: 我的四肢撑着一副空壳
lines.en: My limbs hold up an empty shell
There is nothing on this land

lines.zh: 我把重心放在一条腿上
lines.en: I rest my weight on one leg

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂着，不怎么动
lines.en: My tail hangs, barely moving

lines.zh: 我在等一阵风带来味道
lines.en: I wait for a wind to bring a scent

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，眼球很干
lines.en: My eyes are large and my eyeballs are dry
My ears turned half a circle
I look down at the cracked earth
I am thinking what my next bite will be

lines.zh: 我的肋骨一次一次起伏
lines.en: My ribs rise and fall, again and again

lines.zh: 我没有躺下，躺下就起不来
lines.en: I do not lie down; lie down and I will not rise
Do you have any food on you

lines.zh: 我们这里什么都长不出来
lines.en: Nothing grows in our land
I am very hungry, but I am still standing
Stand back a bit, I am not steady

lines.zh: 我的牙是用来咬硬东西的
lines.en: My teeth are for biting hard things
You are hesitating, I see it
I will not lunge first
But the moment you leave, I will follow
I have not eaten my fill in a long time
Your shadow is heavier than mine
I keep a distance from it
The blow knocked me flat
I am too thin, I cannot block it
One of my ribs is broken
Less blood than I expected
I get up slowly

lines.zh: 这一点伤我就起不来了
lines.en: A wound this small and I cannot rise
I lie there, breathing loudly
Half a tooth chipped off
My herd calls from afar
I have not finished that mouthful
There is something edible on your hand
I lift a leg and shift once

lines.zh: 我很饿，这一点我很确定
lines.en: I am hungry, of that I am certain
Hold it a little higher
My jaw is trembling
This will keep me chewing a long while
I have no strength to snatch
I smell it, very strongly

lines.zh: 这是我这个月最香的东西
lines.en: This is the best thing I have smelled this month
My legs walked forward on their own
Do not move, I will be there soon
I can only walk, I cannot run
Half a step back from you is enough

lines.zh: 我把舌头伸出来舔了舔干裂的嘴
lines.en: I lick my cracked lips
You nearly knocked me down
This body of mine is very light

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我的肋骨响
lines.en: We bumped, and my ribs clicked
You are much stronger than I am
I stepped back twice before steadying
My bones must have hurt you, sorry

lines.zh: 我倒下过一次，不想再倒
lines.en: I have fallen once, I do not want to again
My legs are shaking
Your foot is on my tail
I have no strength to argue over the path

lines.zh: 你退开的时候我还在晃
lines.en: I was still swaying when you backed off
I set my teeth and stood straight
Our herd lives very tightly
Such a thing would make us weaker
There is not enough in the ground to share
I have no strength for such thoughts
We only walk together
That is already enough

lines.zh: 我低下头看自己的影子
lines.en: I lower my head and look at my shadow
This season should not hold such things
I keep searching ahead
Just follow along
I lower my head and pick something up
This is a dried root
It bites very hard
I chewed it for a long time

lines.zh: 地上有一点能吃的东西
lines.en: There is something edible on the ground
I cannot bear to drop it
I hold it in my mouth
This will carry me a stretch
I got it down, dry as it was
My throat is dry and sore
Something is making noise there
I raise my head and aim that way

lines.zh: 我们成群的时候才敢靠近
lines.en: We only dare approach in a group
It looks thinner than I am
I will watch first, no rush
The herd is at my back
That shape has my eye

lines.zh: 这片地里的活物都要小心
lines.en: Living things on this land must be careful
I circle over slowly
I lower my head to the roots
It did not run, good
My legs are tired, but I do not stop
I move along the dead grass
The wind brings its scent
My jaw opens and closes again
It backs off, I go slower
The gap keeps closing
I wait for its first move
I open my mouth and bite
There is little strength in this bite
My teeth sank into its hide
I ram with my whole body
It shook me off
My jaw hurts

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我的力气
lines.en: That used all my strength
I staggered back a few steps
I will bite once more

lines.zh: 我从饥饿原野里走出来
lines.en: I walk out of the Hungering Fields
Four of us together, walking very slowly
This land has already withered
My teeth are still whole
I smell new air
My herd follows me
First we find water, then food

lines.zh: 这里的地比我们那边软
lines.en: The ground here is softer than ours
I look down at this land
We will not stay long

lines.zh: 火一烤，我身上的油都在响
lines.en: Fire hisses on the little fat I have
I rolled down the slope

lines.zh: 水灌进我的气管，我挣扎不起来
lines.en: Water filled my windpipe and I could not struggle up

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推到很远的地方
lines.en: The blast threw me far

lines.zh: 一根箭扎在我的肋骨之间
lines.en: An arrow lodged between my ribs

lines.zh: 那股术力让我全身的骨头都疼
lines.en: That magic made every bone ache

lines.zh: 我一直都饿，但这次是真的撑不住了
lines.en: I am always hungry, but this time I truly cannot go on

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我一下子软了
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and I went limp

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我连挣扎的力气都没有
lines.en: The ground is gone and I have no strength left to struggle
